raw_snippet: Since 2024, investors have put $94.3 billion into 119 AI research labs. Most are pre-revenue and some are pre-product, by design. Only 16 disclose any revenue at all.
value_text: Leonis Capital counts $94.3B raised by 119 neolabs since 2024, of which 16 disclose any revenue: money raised and a lab count, but no revenue denominator.
